      • testRegisterNamedObjectWithWhitespaceName

        public void testRegisterNamedObjectWithWhitespaceName()
        As with registering an object with a null name, this should also work. However, the whitespace name used should be given to the instance. Although it isn't very elegant to use such a value for a name, it shouldn't be illegal
